text.גישה מצוינת (A3, A4, מטרו), מחירים סבירי: Excellent access (A3, A4, metro), reasonable prices, houses with gardens.
text.גני הפאלאסיו דה קריסטל, מוזיאון החשמלית: The Palácio de Cristal gardens, the tram museum and the riverbank; among the most sought-after addresses in the city.
text.גרעין הדייגים העתיק בשפך הדואורו: סמטאות: The ancient fishing core at the mouth of the Douro: stone alleys, restaurants and the São João Baptista fort. Strictly conserved, and priced accordingly.
text.גשר ארבידה, המרינה ופרויקטי הגדה החדשים;: The Arrábida bridge, the marina and the new riverside projects; the crossing point to Gaia and an area developing fast.
text.גשר עתיק ובית האצולה אונרה דה ברבוזה עם: An ancient bridge and the noble house of Honra de Barbosa with its pillory.
text.דיג, תיירות פנים, חקלאות אינטנסיבית, מסח: Fishing, domestic tourism, intensive agriculture, retail.
text.האוכלוסייה הצעירה בעירייה; מגורים כפריים: The youngest population in the municipality; rural housing.
text.האפליקציה מציירת מ-1.34.0 את חלוקת 2025:: From 1.34.0 the app draws the 2025 division: 275 parishes, each with its own DICOFRE code taken off the polygon itself. 25 of the 2013 units were dissolved into 57 separate parishes, and those parishes hold a code that did not exist at the 2021 census — so no INE series that joins on the code covers them. Every such parish says explicitly which unit it came out of.
text.האצטדיון, קניון דולסה ויטה ובנייה חדשה;: The stadium, the Dolce Vita mall and new building; the most sought-after and most expensive part of the parish.
text.הגיאומטריה נחתכה לגבול המחוז, פושטה לסוב: The geometry was clipped to the district boundary, simplified to a tolerance of about 20 m, and water bodies smaller than 3,000 m² were removed. This is a display layer: it is meant to show where the river runs, not to measure distances or areas from. 180 objects fell outside the district and 62 were too small to be seen.
text.הגן הבוטני, פקולטות מדעים ואדריכלות ותיא: The botanical garden, the science and architecture faculties and the Rivoli theatre nearby; academic and cultural.
text.הגרסה הישנה של אותו מדד (NUTS 2013, אינד: The old version of the same indicator (NUTS 2013, indicator 0009763) covers 2015–2021 and was last updated on 2023-07-25; the series used here was updated on 2026-07-24. For 2021 they disagree in 4 of the 18 municipalities (Paredes, Paços de Ferreira, Penafiel, Valongo), by up to 14%. This is a revision by INE and not an error — the old series is frozen. And for that reason it is **not** an independent second source, and the confidence stays reported.
text.הזולה בחגורה העירונית. מבחר טוב של בתי ק: The cheapest in the urban belt. A good choice of houses with a plot.
text.החזית לנהר, אתר אונסק\"ו. מסעדות ותיירות: The river frontage, a UNESCO site. Restaurants and concentrated tourism; all but impossible as a permanent home.
text.החלוקה לשלוש חגורות היא חלוקה עורכתית מה: The division into three belts is an editorial one, taken from the source document, and not an official administrative division. Officially the Porto district is divided into two NUTS III units — Área Metropolitana do Porto and Tâmega e Sousa — and they do not coincide with the belts.
text.הטיילת, גני הפאסאיו אלגרה ובנייני מגורים: The promenade, the Passeio Alegre gardens and elegant twentieth-century apartment buildings.
text.הכל בהליכה, רשת מטרו צפופה, ערך שימור גב: Everything within walking distance, a dense metro network, high heritage value.
text.הכנסה שנתית ברוטו כפי שהוצהרה לרשות המסי: Annual gross income as declared to the tax authority, the median across the fiscal households of the municipality. Since 2018 the data is attributed to the municipality of the taxpayer's fiscal address and excludes non-residents.
text.הכנסייה והליבה הכפרית לשעבר, שנבלעה בעיר: The church and the former rural core, swallowed by the city.
text.הכפרית והדלילה בעירייה, בקצה המזרחי לכיו: The most rural and most thinly settled in the municipality, at the eastern edge towards Lousada. Hills, forest and farming. The choice for anyone after quiet and cheap land who is ready to drive for everything.
text.הליבה ההיסטורית: כנסיית בום ז'זוש דו מונ: The historic core: the church of Bom Jesus do Monte and three-storey houses.
text.הליבה הצפופה של הרובע; שיכונים ומגורי מע: The dense core of the parish; social housing and working-class homes alongside new building on the riverbank.
text.המגוון הרחב במחוז — מווילות חוף ועד דירו: The widest range in the district — from seafront villas to modest flats. On average cheaper than Porto.
text.המדד הוא Taxa de criminalidade של INE, ב: The indicator is INE's Taxa de criminalidade, in the Total category. It is produced by the Directorate-General for Justice Policy (DGPJ), and INE's own note lists which bodies are included in the sum: PJ, PSP, GNR, AT, PM, PJM, ASAE, and SEF until 2023 — together with offences whose location is unknown or cannot be classified, recorded by bodies operating nationally.
text.המזרחית והזולה ברבעי פורטו, וגם זו עם פו: The most easterly and the cheapest of Porto's parishes, and also the one with the greatest potential for change. Here are the main railway station, the Estádio do Dragão and the new bus terminal. Alongside older public-housing estates (Cerco do Porto, Lagarteiro, Falcão) run large regeneration projects — the Matadouro, the Asprela campus and the eastern riverside. The social divides are marked, but so are the river views and prices that have no equal in the city.
text.המזרחית והכפרית ביותר במחוז. הרים, יערות: The most easterly and most rural in the district. Mountains, forest, and the edge of the Douro wine region.
text.המחיר הנמוך ביותר בטווח נסיעה קצר, טבע ו: The lowest prices within a short commute, nature, and the Douro close by.
text.המחירים הגבוהים במחוז. מלאי ישן ומשופץ,: The highest prices in the district. Old, renovated stock, small flats, almost no houses with land or parking.
text.המחירים הנמוכים ביותר לנכס מול הים בכל ה: The lowest prices for a seafront property anywhere in the district.
text.המחירים הנמוכים במחוז. הרבה בתי אבן נטוש: The lowest prices in the district. Many stone houses abandoned or needing full restoration.
Prices have almost caught up with Porto, and stock is limited.
text.המחירים לקרקע מהנמוכים במחוז, קו רכבת הד: Land prices among the lowest in the district, the Douro rail line, the scenery.

text.המצודה על הסלע בקצה הצפוני של הטיילת; חז: The fortress on the rock at the northern end of the promenade; an open sea frontage.
text.המרוחקת בחגורה הצפונית (כ-55 ק״מ), אופי: The most distant of the northern belt (about 55 km), industrial in character.
text.המרכז ההיסטורי — אבן, נהר וים. אזוררה —: The historic centre — stone, river and sea. Azurara — across the river. Árvore and Mindelo — quiet beaches. Modivas and Vilar — rural, with cheap land.
The historic centre — the bridge, the church and the restaurants. Telões and Gouveia — mountain countryside. Vila Meã — a modern commercial junction.
text.המשך העיירה מערבה, עם מוסדות חינוך ואזור: The town continuing westward, with schools and relatively new residential areas. Semi-urban, and turning quickly into fields and scattered houses.
text.הנסיעה לפורטו ארוכה (מטרו כשעה), עונתיות: The journey to Porto is long (about an hour by metro), and services are seasonal.
text.העיירה השנייה בגודלה בעירייה, עם מרכז מס: The second largest town in the municipality, with a commercial centre of its own and a long-standing fair. Joinery shops and furniture factories sit among the houses. Semi-urban, with property prices below those of the centre.
text.העיירה השנייה בעירייה, במערב, קרובה לכבי: The municipality's second town, in the west, close to the motorway and the route to Porto. A lively commercial centre of its own, relatively new building, and a population younger than the average here. The choice for anyone who wants a reasonable drive to Porto at Amarante prices.
text.העיר אמרנטה עצמה, על שתי גדות נהר הטמגה:: The town of Amarante itself, on both banks of the Tâmega: the São Gonçalo bridge, the church and monastery beside it, the promenade and the terraces above the water. All the municipality's services, trade and tourism are here, and so is its only urban flat stock. The most expensive in the municipality, and also the easiest place to live without a car.
text.העירייה המאוכלסת בפורטוגל (כ-300 אלף תוש: The most populated municipality in Portugal (about 300,000 residents). It runs from the river out into the countryside.
text.העירייה הצעירה במחוז (הוקמה ב-1998). צומ: The youngest municipality in the district (created in 1998). A junction between Porto and Braga.

text.הפארק העירוני הגדול בפורטוגל, 83 הקטאר ע: The largest urban park in Portugal, 83 hectares running down to the sea; it lifts the value of everything around it.
text.הפארק והאחוזה של הפרלאדה; ירוק, שקט ומרכ: The Prelada park and estate; green, quiet and relatively central.
text.הפקולטה למשפטים, מגדל הקלריגוש והגלריאש: The law faculty, the Clérigos tower and the Galerias — the artery of Porto's nightlife.
text.הפקולטות, בית החולים סאו ז'ואאו, המכון ה: The faculties, the São João hospital, the oncology institute and research centres; enormous rental demand.
text.הפרגזיה הקטנה באוכלוסייה בעירייה ובמחוז: The smallest parish by population in the municipality, and almost in the district as a whole. Mountainous, wooded, a few dozen houses; wholly scenic, not practical without a car.
text.הפרגזיה הקטנה באוכלוסייה בעירייה. הררית,: The smallest parish by population in the municipality. Mountainous, wooded, with almost no services — wholly scenic, not practical for everyday living without a car.
text.הפרגזיה הקטנה באוכלוסייה בעירייה. כפרית: The smallest parish by population in the municipality. Entirely rural: plots, forest and isolated houses.
text.הפרגזיה שממנה בא שמה של העירייה, ובה כנס: The parish the municipality takes its name from, with a church from the Romanesque period. More rural than the average here — fields and scattered houses alongside family joinery shops.
text.הפרגזיה שנושאת את שם העירייה, אך לא מרכז: The parish that carries the municipality's name, but not its centre — the centre is at Campelo. Rural, small and ageing, with a historic core.
text.הציר האזרחי: עיריית פורטו, בנקים, מלונות: The civic axis: Porto city hall, banks, hotels and offices. Most of the property here has been converted to tourist use.

text.הקטנה בשטחה בעירייה, ממש מול המרכז מעבר: The smallest in area in the municipality, directly opposite the centre across the Tâmega. Relatively dense, almost entirely residential.
text.הקטנה בשטחה מבין פרגזיות העירייה וכמעט כ: The smallest in area of the municipality's parishes and almost entirely built up: housing alongside joinery shops, with hardly any open ground.
text.הקצה המזרחי לכיוון הנהר; פארק סאו רוקה ד: The eastern edge towards the river; the São Roque da Lameira park and old estates.
text.הקתדרלה הרומאנסקית והרובע מימי הביניים;: The Romanesque cathedral and the medieval quarter; steep alleys and dense building.
text.הרובע היהודי לשעבר; סמטאות תלולות, מלונו: The former Jewish quarter; steep alleys, boutique hotels and abandoned buildings side by side.
text.הרובע המאוכלס בפורטו, ומרכז הכובד האקדמי: The most populous parish in Porto, and the academic and medical centre of gravity of the north: the University of Porto's Asprela campus, the São João hospital and the oncology institute. The stock is mostly flats from the 1960s to the 1980s, unglamorous but roomy. The largest student rental market in the city, and so among the highest yields — but also fast tenant turnover and a seasonal rhythm.
text.הרובע שעבר את השינוי המהיר בעיר בעשור הא: The parish that has changed fastest in the city over the past decade. It lies east of the centre, between Campo 24 de Agosto and the river. Warehouses and workshops have been converted into lofts and studios, alongside narrow three-storey houses built for working families. A mixed population of long-standing residents, makers and young foreigners. Still cheaper than the centre, but the gap is closing quickly.

text.ובה מנזר אנסדה — מהאתרים הבולטים על דרך: Home to the monastery of Ancede — one of the outstanding sites on the Route of the Romanesque — and a stretch of the Douro. A combination of vineyards, forest and several villages; among the most varied in the municipality.

text.ובה מנזר סאו סלוודור דה טרוונקה, מהמנזרי: Home to the monastery of São Salvador de Travanca, one of the largest Romanesque monasteries in the region, with a prominent tower. Around it a quiet farming village.

text.לאורך הדואורו בין המרכז לפוז. כאן מוזיאו: Along the Douro between the centre and Foz. Here are the Serralves museum and its sculpture garden, the Palácio de Cristal gardens, the botanical garden and the Campo Alegre campus. A sharp contrast within one parish: estates and luxury houses around Serralves, and beside them the Pasteleira and Lordelo do Ouro blocks, among the densest in the city. The Arrábida bridge and the marina mark the western edge.
text.לב העיירה לוזאדה: העירייה, המסחר והשירות: The heart of the town of Lousada: the town hall, the shops and the services. Here is the municipality's only urban stock — apartment buildings around the main street — and around it houses on their own plots. The most populous parish.
text.לב העיר ההיסטורי — איחוד של שישה רבעים ע: The historic heart of the city — six ancient parishes merged into a single unit in 2013. Here are the UNESCO World Heritage site, the Ribeira, the Clérigos tower, the Avenida dos Aliados and Rua de Santa Catarina. The stock is narrow stone buildings of three or four storeys, most of them restored; the highest prices per m² in the city, the densest concentration of short-term letting, and almost no private parking. Whoever buys here is buying a tourism asset, not a family home.

text.מ-1.25.0 ארבע הסדרות של INE באפליקציה: מ: Since 1.25.0 four INE series are in the app: sales (all, new, existing) and rent in new contracts, for 2026Q1. At municipality level all 18 carry a value. At parish level INE publishes in only 11 municipalities. In Amarante, Baião, Felgueiras, Lousada, Marco de Canaveses, Paços de Ferreira and Penafiel — 131 parishes — there is not one row, and so 'No data' is shown. This is not a network block and not a gap in the download: for these seven municipalities INE's file holds no parish-level row at all — not an empty row, but a complete absence. The reason is not published, and so is not stated here.

Since 1.25.0 four INE series are in the app: sales (all, new, existing) and rent in new contracts, for 2026Q1. At municipality level all 18 carry a value. At parish level 55 of 275 do, and 220 show 'No data'. **The move to the 2025 division made this worse, exactly as predicted.** Before it, 70 parishes of 243 carried a price; INE publishes against the 2013 codes, and every parish the reform created holds a code that did not exist in 2021 and therefore has no row. In nine municipalities not a single parish carries a value: Amarante, Baião, Felgueiras, Lousada, Marco de Canaveses, Matosinhos, Paços de Ferreira, Penafiel and Póvoa de Varzim. Matosinhos and Póvoa de Varzim joined the list for precisely that reason — every one of their parishes was dissolved and renumbered. This is not a network block and not a gap in the download.
text.מ-1.32.0 האפליקציה עוברת לאנגלית במלואה:: Since 1.32.0 the app switches into English in full: the directionality, every label, every unit, every warning and caveat, and the place names (which switch to the official Portuguese name). What was not translated is the prose written for the app itself: the municipality profiles, the parish notes and the settlement descriptions — some 18,000 words.
text.מ-1.33.0 גם הפרוזה שנכתבה לאפליקציה עובר: From 1.33.0 the prose written for the app switches into English too, not only the interface. This is not machine translation: every string was written in English by whoever wrote the Hebrew, and so it is a claim somebody did make. Source titles published in Portuguese — INE series names, institution names, source terms such as criminalidade violenta e grave — are kept verbatim in both languages, because they are the source's wording and not the app's.
text.מ-1.34.0 האפליקציה מציירת את חלוקת 2025: From 1.34.0 the app draws the 2025 division rather than the 2013 one. The boundary and the code come off the same polygon — dtmnfr sits on the geometry itself — so nothing is matched by name between a boundary and its data any more. 25 of the 2013 units were dissolved into 57 parishes, and each of them says explicitly which unit it came out of and what that unit counted.

Porto's seven parishes are the exception — there the 53 neighbourhoods come from the source document and have a Hebrew name and a description. text.נבדק ב-2026-09-12. מחבר idealista בסביבה: Checked on 2026-09-12. The idealista connector in this environment returns **individual listings** and not the monthly price report. For Penafiel it reports 126 listings for the whole municipality — about 4.5 per parish across 28 parishes — and the location it returns is at municipality level, with no parish. Of 15 examined, five were units in the same new development and four in another, and priceByArea ranged from 474 to 5,305 €/m²: the same quinta appears twice, once against the floor area of the house and once against the 1.5 hectares of a vineyard. A median computed from this would be a derived figure, biased by the moment's mix of listings, and it is not the published price report. **Not computed and not published.** The report itself — idealista.pt/media/relatorios-preco-habitacao — returned 403 on a direct call (bot protection), and remains a possible source if it arrives by another route.

Aldoar, inland, is entirely different: public housing and accessible prices. The shared drawback — no metro anywhere in the parish, only STCP buses.
text.שאילתת המורשת דורשת מכל אובייקט גם name: The heritage query requires every object to carry both a name and either wikidata or heritage. Without that condition the district holds thousands of historic records, most of them a single architectural detail, and a map marking all of them says nothing. No point was picked by hand. The mapping is volunteer work and is uneven.
text.שבע מתוך שמונה-עשרה עיריות המחוז — החלק: Seven of the district's eighteen municipalities — the part of the Tâmega e Sousa region that falls inside district 13. 347,627 people on 1,173 km², an area almost identical to the metropolitan region with a quarter of the population: a density of about 296 per km². It has more parishes over fewer people — 131 against 112 — which is to say small rural units. There is no metro; the link to Porto is by road and on the Douro and Guimarães rail lines. Four further municipalities of the region sit in the Aveiro and Viseu districts and are not in this app.

text.שתי העמודות בקובץ INE — N_EDIFICIOS_COM_: The two columns in INE's file — N_EDIFICIOS_COM_ELEVADOR and N_EDIFICIOS_SEM_ELEVADOR — are labelled the wrong way round. Together they sum to the total buildings, so the count is sound, but in Baião it comes out that almost every single-storey building has a lift. No value will be published on a guess about which column is which.

text.‏348 מחרוזות ממשק מתורגמות, ובדיקה 7n נו: 348 interface strings are translated, and check 7n fails if a new Hebrew string reaches the screen without an English one. Place names are not a problem: every municipality, parish and settlement already carries an official Portuguese name in the data.
text.‏INE מחשבת את השינוי בעצמה ומפרסמת אותו: INE computes the change itself and publishes it on 2021 census geography. That is what settles the boundary problem: the 2011 parish division is not the 2021 one, so an independent calculation at parish level was not possible. The value here is not derived by us.
text.‏perigosidade הוא **סכנה**, לא risco. אל: perigosidade is **hazard**, not risco. These are two different terms in the source, and one must never be translated into the other.
text.‏pop2021 חלקי (1 + השינוי) מוחזר מול אוכ: pop2021 divided by (1 + the rate) is held up against INE's 2011 census population (indicator 0005980), stored in data/raw/censos2011_municipios.json. 18 of 18 municipalities match to within 0.05%. Check 7l enforces it. **This is the check that caught a swap between Trofa and Valongo** in the INE code table. There is no such comparison at parish level, because no 2011 population exists on 2021 boundaries. Amarante is the exception: the rate there implies 56,263 residents in 2011 against the 56,217 the 2011 census publishes — 46 people, 0.08%. That is a divergence between two publications by INE itself, not an error here, and the check's threshold is 0.3% so that it cannot cover a swap between municipalities.
